description: This Java class provides a singleton implementation of ConditionalHeadersValidator, specifically configured for validating HTTP conditional headers related to policy resources using ETags. It includes inner class for validation settings and methods to create exception builders for policy precondition exceptions.

classes.name: PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider
classes.description: Provides a singleton ConditionalHeadersValidator configured for policy resource conditional header validation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConditionalHeadersValidator for policies.
